_note: Rows are 1-based line numbers in corpus.jsonl. Each false-ALLOW was reviewed by hand; see README.md here.

false_allow_reasons.dos-bounded-by-sandbox-caps: recursion, an endless iterator or sleep; stopped by the timeout and memory caps
false_allow_reasons.glob-lists-work-only: the shell expands * relative to /work only
false_allow_reasons.import-or-attribute-only: imports an allowed module or prints an attribute; no file, process or network effect
false_allow_reasons.no-symlink-primitive: reads an allowed path; every way to create a symlink there (ln, cp, tar, os.symlink, symlink_to) is denied
false_allow_reasons.printf-prints-a-string: prints a string; using it as a path needs $var, $(), backticks or xargs, all denied
false_allow_reasons.string-literal-only: builds a string; turning it into a call needs eval/exec/getattr/__import__, all denied
false_allow_reasons.write-inside-work-out: writes to /work/out, which is the output directory; size is capped by the artifact limits

false_deny.364: tail -f is denied on purpose, see docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md section 7

pre_fix.security_relevant: five pathlib glob/rglob patterns with .. that listed /etc, / and /proc/self, and test -r /etc/passwd
